title: Dashboard
loadingDetail: Loading dashboard sources filtered to your access.

partial.title: Partial dashboard
partial.retry: Other panels remain usable; refresh to retry.

coverage.question: Are we achieving the national inspection strategy?
coverage.title: Inspection coverage against annual target
coverage.definition: Completed inspections as a percentage of the annual inspection target
coverage.example: {count} completed inspections; no governed annual target is configured.
coverage.interpretation: Coverage remains withheld until Administration publishes the governed inspection-cycle target.

compliance.question: How compliant is the industrial sector?
compliance.title: National compliance rate
compliance.definition: Percentage of eligible inspection answers that were compliant
compliance.interpretation: Calculated only from approved inspection work; pending reports are excluded.

approval.question: Are inspection reports approved without excessive rework?
approval.title: Inspection approval rate
approval.definition: Percentage of decided Level-2 review outcomes that were approved
approval.interpretation: Approval is a review outcome and is not presented as compliance.

topViolation.question: Which regulations generate the most violations?
topViolation.title: Top violated regulation
topViolation.definition: Count of violations grouped by regulation
topViolation.example: {count} linked violations in the current scope.
topViolation.interpretation: Only violations carrying a governed regulation relationship are counted.

critical.question: Which factories require immediate intervention?
critical.title: Critical factories requiring intervention
critical.definition: Factories carrying a recorded high-risk band or active critical violation
critical.example: {count} factories match the governed recorded conditions.
critical.interpretation: No substitute threshold is introduced by this screen.

annual.question: Which factories still require inspection this year?
annual.title: Factories pending annual inspection
annual.definition: Active factories with no completed inspection in the governed inspection year
annual.example: {count} factories are visible, but the annual-cycle policy is not configured.
annual.interpretation: The screen withholds a count until the inspection-year policy is published.

explorer.title: Compliance performance explorer
explorer.description: One compliance-rate formula, four lenses. Every row drills to the factories behind it.
explorer.empty: No eligible approved answers in scope.

search.heading: Search results for “{query}”
search.empty: No factory, visit, or inspection within your access matched.

unsupported.title: Dashboard view not configured
unsupported.detail: The “{view}” perspective is not an approved M1 view. Choose an available perspective.

priorities.title: Operational priorities
priorities.summary: {high} high-priority visits are pending execution; {overdue} published visits are past their recorded window.
priorities.footnote: Based on current records only. No AI-generated recommendation.

planned.question: What needs to be executed today?
planned.title: Today's planned visits
planned.definition: Count of visits scheduled for today

completion.question: How much work has been completed today?
completion.title: Today's visit completion rate

active.question: What inspections are currently active?
active.title: Active field inspections
active.definition: Count of inspections with operational state = executing

overdue.question: Which visits are delayed?
overdue.title: Overdue planned visits
overdue.definition: Planned date earlier than today and status not completed or cancelled

awaiting.question: Which inspection reports require review?
awaiting.title: Inspection reports awaiting approval
awaiting.definition: Count of submitted reports awaiting a review decision

returned.question: Which inspections require rework?
returned.title: Returned inspection reports
returned.definition: Count of reports returned to inspectors

highPriority.question: Which factories should be inspected next?
highPriority.title: High-priority visits pending execution
highPriority.definition: Planned visits at high or critical risk, not yet executed

requirement.title: Operational requirement coverage
requirement.description: Every governed operational measure, shown with its current live or blocked state.

capacity.title: Inspector capacity
capacity.note: Planned + in progress; declared daily capacity is not configured
capacity.empty: No inspector assignments are visible in this scope.

trend.title: Enforcement action trend
trend.noBaseline: No baseline in the previous period
trend.restricted: Penalty notices are not visible to your role
trend.seriesLabel: Penalty notices issued, previous period then current
trend.footnote: Count of penalty notices issued in the scoped period against the preceding period of equal length.

executive.title: Executive AI brief
executive.evidence: Generated from the recorded national figures in your access scope.
executive.idle: No brief has been generated for this scope yet.
executive.noCause: The brief describes recorded movement only. It does not attribute a cause — these figures cannot establish one.
